card_title: How to choose the best digital marketing agency in Delhi NCR
card_text: A 10-point checklist, the questions to ask on the first call, red flags and what a fair 90-day plan looks like.
intro:
Search for the best digital marketing agency in Delhi NCR and you'll find hundreds of agencies, each calling itself number one. Most of those lists are written by the agencies themselves. So instead of another ranking, this guide gives you the checklist we'd use if we were hiring an agency for our own business.

Use it to compare any agency, including us. If an agency can't pass most of these checks, keep looking.

sections.h2: Start with the result you want, not the service
sections.html:
Businesses often ask for "SEO" or "Instagram marketing" when what they actually need is more admissions, more site visits or more orders. The best agency for you is the one that understands your result and picks the channels to match it.

Before you call anyone, write down three numbers: how many leads or customers you want each month, what one customer is worth to you, and the monthly budget you can put behind marketing. A good agency will ask for these in the first ten minutes.

CheckWhat good looks like
1. Relevant proofCase studies from your industry with real numbers such as cost per lead, not just logos
2. Revenue focusThey talk about leads, cost per customer and sales, not likes and reach
3. TrackingForms, calls and WhatsApp clicks tracked end to end from day one
4. Creative in-houseThey make the ads and videos themselves and test new ones every week
5. Lead follow-upA plan for replying to every lead within minutes, ideally automated on WhatsApp
6. Your ad accountsAds run in accounts you own, so you keep the data if you leave
7. Clear pricingManagement fee and ad budget shown separately
8. Short commitmentA 60 to 90-day sprint first, not a 12-month lock-in
9. Simple reportingOne report that shows spend, leads, cost per lead and sales
10. Local knowledgeThey know how people in Delhi, Gurugram, Noida or your area search and buy

sections.h2: Questions to ask on the first call
sections.html:
• Who will actually run my account? Meet them. In many agencies, the person who sells is not the person who works.
  • What would you do in the first 30 days? A good answer is specific: tracking setup, landing page fixes, first creatives and a test budget.
  • What cost per lead should I expect? They should give a range based on similar clients and explain what changes it. For example, our rooftop solar campaigns run at ₹60–80 per lead.
  • How will you know if leads are good? Look for qualifying questions on forms and a feedback loop with your sales team.
  • What happens if it doesn't work? Honest agencies explain how they test, when they'd change direction and how you can exit.

sections.h2: Red flags to walk away from
sections.html:
• Guaranteed rankings or guaranteed ROI. Nobody controls Google or Meta. Promises like "page 1 in 30 days" usually mean shortcuts that can hurt you later.
  • Ads run from the agency's own account. If you leave, your history and data leave with them.
  • Reports full of impressions and followers. If the report never mentions leads or sales, the agency isn't tracking them.
  • One plan for everyone. A school, a clinic and a solar installer need very different campaigns.
  • Long lock-ins before any results. Good agencies are confident enough to earn the renewal.

sections.h2: What a fair 90-day plan looks like
sections.html:
1. Weeks 1–2: audit, tracking setup, landing page or website fixes, Google Business Profile cleanup.
  2. Weeks 3–6: first campaigns live on the channels that fit your goal, with 5 to 10 creatives in testing and WhatsApp follow-up switched on.
  3. Weeks 7–12: cut what doesn't convert, scale what does, add retargeting and a review system.

By day 90 you should know your real cost per lead and cost per customer, and whether it makes sense to scale. Paid ads can bring enquiries within days; local SEO builds more slowly over three to six months.

If one channel drives most of your business, a specialist often beats a generalist. A solar marketing agency already knows the subsidy hooks, lead-form questions and creatives that work for rooftop solar. A Google Ads agency or a Facebook and Instagram ads agency goes deeper on that one platform.

If you need ads, creative, website and follow-up working together, look for one team that owns all of it, so nobody can blame another vendor when leads drop.

sections.h2: Where to look in Delhi NCR
sections.html: Ask businesses in your industry who they use, check agencies' own Google reviews, and look at the case studies on their websites. Visit the office if you can. We're based in Dwarka, and you can see our Delhi NCR services and solar case studies before you decide.

faqs: Which is the best digital marketing agency in Delhi NCR?

There is no single best agency for everyone. The best one for you has proof in your industry, tracks leads and sales rather than likes, runs ads in accounts you own, and offers a short first commitment. Use the 10-point checklist above to compare your shortlist.
How much does a digital marketing agency charge in Delhi NCR?
Pricing depends on scope. Most agencies charge a monthly management fee plus your ad budget, which should be shown separately. Ask for both numbers upfront and for the cost per lead they expect.
How long before I see results from a marketing agency?

Paid ads on Google, Facebook and Instagram usually bring enquiries within the first one to two weeks. Profitable, steady results typically take 30 to 90 days of testing. SEO usually takes three to six months.
Should I hire a local agency in Delhi NCR?

A local agency understands how people in your area search and buy, and you can meet in person. That helps most for local businesses such as clinics, schools, coaching institutes, real estate and solar installers.
